description: SUMO Luxembourg scenario LuST provides the LuST road-traffic simulation scenario for SUMO. The provider is Luxembourg SUMO Traffic research team. Geographical and temporal coverage: The scenario concerns Luxembourg and was validated with SUMO 0.26. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The developers explicitly warn that outputs with newer SUMO versions are not validated and recommend MoST for newer versions. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
